notes.why_in_news: Jakarta has overtaken Tokyo as the world’s most populous city according to a UN study, highlighting the rapid urbanisation trends.
notes.fact_box: Jakarta is home to 42 million people, followed by Dhaka with 37 million. Tokyo, previously the top city, now has 33 million people. The shift is due to new methodology in the UN's World Urbanisation Prospects 2025 report.
